summary_rationale: On a strictly price-blind fundamental audit, Donnelley Financial Solutions (DFIN) earns a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL business quality verdict with PASS on leading operational KPIs. Since its October 2016 spin-off from R.R. Donnelley, DFIN has executed a high-ROIC (18.25%) transformation from legacy financial print into a cloud regulatory-compliance SaaS platform: Software Solutions grew from 22% of net sales in 2019 to 46.7% ($358.4M) in FY2025 and crossed the 51.5% majority threshold in Q3 2026, anchored by ActiveDisclosure (+24% to +29% YoY in 2026, >$100M TTM) and Arc Suite. Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA margins expanded to a record 31.3% ($239.8M) in FY2025 with $107.8M in free cash flow (45.0% conversion) and conservative net leverage (~0.6x Adjusted EBITDA; $171.3M total debt vs. $24.5M cash) following an $82.8M pension settlement. The verdict is CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than COMPOUNDER_PASS because roughly half of total revenue—Compliance & Communications Management ($408.6M in FY2025) and transactional Venue Virtual Data Rooms—remains exposed to capital-markets IPO/M&A cycles and secular physical print runoff, keeping multi-year consolidated top-line growth modest.
